pages.text: Class gear by tier:$(li)Tier 1: anyone can craft it$(li)Diamond tier 2 at job level 10$(li)Netherite tier 3 at 20$(li)Armory sets at 25$(br2)$(l)Smith$(): plate armor and melee weapons. $(l)Hunter$(): leather armor, bows, crossbows, spears, quivers. $(l)Enchanter$(): robes, staves, wands, instruments.$(br2)Vanilla diamond and netherite swords and armor, and the boss-material sets (Ignitium, Cursium, Dragon Bones...), count as Smith tier 2 and 3 too.

$(l)Enchanter$() shelves: Hellshelf and Seashelf at 10, their upgrades at 20, deep and sculk shelves at 25, endshelves at 30.$(br)$(l)Alchemist$(): Strong and Long potions at 10, Splash at 15, Lingering at 20.$(br)$(l)Smith$() reforging: Rare at 10, Epic at 20, Mythic at 30.$(br2)Hover over an item to see who makes it.

$(l)Jeweler$(): gold and gem jewelry at 10, Socket Mounts at 15, diamond and emerald jewelry at 20, netherite jewelry at 25. Copper and iron rings are free.$(br2)The Jeweler villager sells rings and necklaces, and dungeons hide them.

$(l)Cook$(): plated meals and hearty dishes (4-5 ingredients) at 10, feasts and grand dishes (6 or more) at 20. Simple dishes and cooking pot meals are free for everyone.$(br2)$(l)Explorer$(): scrolls and Crypt Survey Maps at 10, Warp Stones and Sharestones at 15, Waystones, Portstones and Great Dungeon maps at 20, Warp Plates at 25, Boss Lair maps at 30.
